fields.name: record_id
fields.description: Unique record identifier (required by application, nullable for BQ compatibility)

fields.name: record_hash
fields.description: DEPRECATED legacy scalar (kept additively for old-row/back-compat reads). Canonical record hashes now live in record_hashes[] as tuples (content_type='record_markdown'). Migration: buttermilk-1e23cce6.

fields.name: content
fields.description: Record content (required by application, nullable for BQ compatibility)

fields.name: ground_truth
fields.description: Canonical home for the record's ground-truth/expected label (academic-integrity: the true label belongs in the canonical record, not re-embedded in inputs). Its hash is a tuple in record_hashes[] (content_type='ground_truth').

fields.name: record_hashes
fields.description: Canonical list of record-identity hash tuples (convention: hashes are tuple-lists, not per-field scalar columns). One entry per logical unit: each content part (content_type='text'/'image' with part_index), the whole-record markdown (content_type='record_markdown'), and ground_truth (content_type='ground_truth'). Tamper-evidence + dedup layer.

fields.name: part_index
fields.description: Ordinal within a multi-part content record; null for whole-record/ground_truth units.
